body: Closes the 'XP earned isn't written back to IDUNA yet' gap. idunaclient.Client already had a real, unused UpdateCharacterLevel method (PATCH /api/v1/characters/:id). Respawn handler now calls it after computing post-penalty currentXP, fire-and-forget via goroutine + log-on-error, same pattern PacketSkillXP's own IncrementSkill call already uses. go build/test clean. Commit c183b9f.
title: Respawn XP penalty now persists back to IDUNA
